title: Smoked Turkey Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with smoked turkey, youthful vegetables, and a hint of Greek spices.

ingredients.name: Smoked Turkey Neck
ingredients.notes: you can use other smoked turkey parts if available

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the smoked turkey neck and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the onion and cook until softened.
Add the carrots, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour in the water and tomatoes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Shred or chop the turkey neck and return it to the pot.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
